prompt: Create a high-resolution vertical portrait photograph of a young East Asian woman dressed as an opulent ancient imperial princess, centered in frame and looking directly into the camera with wide expressive eyes. She wears a lavish cream-and-gold embroidered hanfu-style robe with red inner layers, ornate floral gold brocade, a structured golden belt with a green jade centerpiece, and flowing sleeves. Her hair is styled in a high formal updo with straight bangs, topped by an extremely elaborate gold phoenix-and-floral crown featuring filigree, pearls, teardrop gemstones, dangling pearl chains, and tassels. She holds both hands up near shoulder height making two V-sign peace gestures, one on each side of her face. A realistic Japanese 10,000 yen banknote is held horizontally across her mouth, covering her lips like a playful gag; the note should clearly show the large “10000” denomination and Japanese banknote styling. The background is a luxurious golden palace interior with warm amber lighting, carved dark wood panels, glowing lanterns, bokeh highlights, and a gold dragon sculpture blurred on the left, creating a rich imperial atmosphere. Use cinematic warm color grading, shallow depth of field, sharp facial detail, realistic skin texture, symmetrical composition, ornate textures, and ultra-detailed jewelry. The mood is glamorous, playful, and extravagant, like a premium fashion cosplay editorial. Customize the subject as young East Asian imperial princess, the outfit palette as cream, gold, and red, the mouth prop as Japanese 10,000 yen banknote, the background setting as luxurious golden palace interior, and the hand pose as two V-sign peace gestures.

promptZh: 创作一张高分辨率的竖构图肖像照片，画面中心是一位年轻的东亚女性，她装扮成华丽的古代帝国公主，直视镜头，双眼灵动有神。她身穿一件奢华的米金色刺绣汉服风格长袍，内衬红色，饰有华丽的花卉金锦，腰间系着带有绿玉装饰的结构化金腰带，袖口宽大飘逸。她的发型是高耸的正式发髻，配有齐刘海，头戴极其精致的金色凤凰花卉冠冕，饰有花丝、珍珠、水滴状宝石、垂下的珍珠链和流苏。她双手举至肩部高度，做出两个 V 字剪刀手姿势，分别位于脸部两侧。一张写实的日本 1 万日元纸币横向衔在嘴前，像俏皮的口塞一样遮住嘴唇；纸币应清晰显示巨大的“10000”面额和日本纸币的样式。背景是奢华的金色宫殿内部，灯光温暖呈琥珀色，配有雕花深色木板、发光的灯笼、焦外成像光斑，左侧模糊可见金龙雕塑，营造出浓郁的帝国氛围。使用电影感暖色调调色、浅景深、清晰的面部细节、真实的皮肤纹理、对称构图、华丽的纹理和超精细的珠宝。氛围华丽、俏皮且奢华，如同高端时尚 Cosplay 专题大片。自定义主体为 年轻的东亚帝国公主，服装配色为 米色、金色和红色，嘴部道具为 日本 1 万日元纸币，背景设置为 奢华的金色宫殿内部，手部动作为 两个 V 字剪刀手姿势。
